series: Things Living In Your House, Part 21
sources: Connecticut Agricultural Experiment Station, House Centipede fact sheet (K. Dugas): 15 pairs of legs; hunts cockroach nymphs, bed bugs, flies, ants, silverfish, spiders; venomous forcipules sting prey; stinging a human is very rare, only from rough handling; flees when discovered; nocturnal; https://portal.ct.gov/-/media/caes/documents/publications/fact_sheets/entomology/house_centipede_scutigera.pdf
Penn State Extension, House Centipedes: feeds on silverfish, carpet beetle larvae, cockroaches, spiders; harmless; https://extension.psu.edu/house-centipedes
Washington State University Extension PestSense, House centipede: hunts flies, cockroaches, moths at night; https://pestsense.cahnrs.wsu.edu/fact-sheet/house-centipede/

title: Never Squish the 30-Legged Bug in Your House
tiktok_caption: house centipede part 2 🐛 it hunts the bed bugs and roaches in your house. Would you let it stay? 🐛 stay / 🙅 squish

beats.say: You just saw the thirty-legged bug in your bathroom.
It eats bed bugs and baby cockroaches.
Squish it, and they all stay.
